Regelrechte Artikulation im linken Kniegelenk. Geringes subchondrales Ödem an der medialen Femurkondyle (5/18). Ansonsten unauffälliges Knochenmarkssignal. Kleine Fabella (7/23). Chondropathie retropatellar, fokal teils auch tiefergreifende (z. B. 6/20) ansonsten weitestgehend erhaltener Knorpelbesatz ansonsten weitestgehend erhaltener Knorpelbesatz femoropatellar. Femorotibial insbesondere medial in der Belastungszone flächig ausgedünnter Knorpelbesatz bei der Gelenkpartner ohne vollschichtige tief greifende Läsion. Außenmeniskus intakt. Am Innenmeniskus Nachweis eines Lappenrisses am Übergang Pars intermedia zum Hinterhorn mit nach paratibial umgeschlagenem Anteil (5/21). Um das MCL geringe Flüssigkeitseinlagerungen. 
Laterales Kollateralband unauffällig. Geringer Gelenkerguss. Synovia gering verdickt, DD bei Reizzustand. Unauffällige Darstellung der miterfassten umgebenden Muskulatur und Subkutis. Teils varikös erweiterte Venen subkutan.

Findings:  No evidence of significant knee effusion. Normal medial and lateral menisci. No evidence of tears.  Normal ACL, PCL, MCL and LCL. Normal extensor mechanism.  There is mild - moderate thinning of the medial compartment articular cartilage. The lateral tibiofemoral and patellofemoral articular cartilage is preserved.  
Conclusion: Medial compartment degenerate change noted. No associated meniscal tear.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Gonalgia bilateral.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Meniscos impresionan de morfología y señal conservada, sin signos categóricos de rotura.
Cartílagos de los compartimentos femorotibiales y de la tróclea femoral sin alteraciones. Úlceras
condrales de espesor parcial y prácticamente total de la faceta medial de la rótula, sin cambios
óseos secundarios.
No hay derrame articular ni quistes poplíteos.
Discreto aumento de señal de la región insercional distal del tendón cuadricipital y de la inserción
proximal del tendón rotuliano, sin signos de rotura.
Tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial sin alteraciones significativas.
Impresión:
Condropatía lesiones grado dos y tres de la faceta medial de la rótula.
Leve tendinosis rotuliana proximal y cuadricipital distal

There is an undisplaced horizontal oblique tear through the posterior horn of the medial meniscus, along with a small bilobed posteriorly located meniscal cyst. A small joint effusion is present, no loose bodies have been demonstrated.  The lateral meniscus is normal.  The ACL, PCL, medial and lateral collateral ligaments are intact.  The medial and lateral tibiofemoral articular cartilage is well preserved.  
A well-defined ring of sclerosis with internal marrow signal characteristics is noted along the central portion of the lateral femoral condyle, with no surrounding marrow edema like signal change. Such appearances are deemed incidental and completely non aggressive in nature, not requiring any further assessment.  Marrow signal characteristics are otherwise reasonably well-maintained.  
Mild distal femoral trochlear dysplasia with a tiny focus of high-grade cartilage loss and associated subchondral marrow change being noted along the inferior aspect of the lateral retropatellar facet. Incidental note is made of a patella alta morphology as per modified Insall Salvati index. No other finding of note.

Rekonverzija koštane srži u dijafizi femura. Ostale prikazane koštane strukture primjerenih
intenziteta signala i morfologije. Prikazana zglobna tijela primjereno su uzglobljena. Manji izljev u
zglobu.
Prikaže se hondromalacija II-III° artikulacijskih hrskavica FT zgloba medijalno.
Degenerativno promijenjeno tijelo i stražnji rog medijalnog meniska uz horizontalnu i suspektnu
kosu rupturu u području stražnjeg roga te znakove parcijalne meniskokapsularne separacije od
posteromedijalne čahure s kranijalne strane. Nalazi se blaga ekstruzija medijalnog meniska koji
potiskuje medijalni kolateralni ligament uz periligamentarni edem.
Prikaže se hondromalacija II-III° artikulacijskih hrskavica FT zgloba lateralno.
Promijenjen intenzitet signala lateralnog meniska u smislu degenerativnih promjena, bez znakova
rupture. Uz prednji korijen nalaze se dvije parameniscealne ciste promjera do 3 mm.
Prednji križni ligament održanog kontinuiteta, blaže promijenjenih intenziteta signala u smislu
degenerativnih promjena.
Povišen intenzitet signala proksimalne trećine stražnjeg križnog ligamenta, može odgovarati
degenerativnim promjenama ili stanju po parcijalnoj rupturi. Uz tibijalno hvatište nalazi se
nekoliko sitnih ganglion cisti promjera do 2 mm.
Lateralni kolateralni ligament je primjerenih intenziteta signala, održanog kontinuiteta.
Hondromalacija I-III° medijalne fasete patele i trohleje femura.
Hondromalacija II° lateralne fasete patele.
Patelarni retinakulumi održani.
Tendinopatski promijenjena tetiva m. semimembranosusa na hvatištu za tibiju.
Uredan prikaz tetive popliteusa, iliotibijalnog trakta i pes anserinus.
Tetiva kvadricepsa primjerenih intenziteta signala, održanog kontinuiteta.
Patelarni ligament blago povišenih intenziteta signala, održanog kontinuiteta, u smislu
entezopatksih promjena.
Ne nalazi se znakova poplitealne ciste.
Prepatelarno manji potkožni edem.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Gonalgia izquierda. Condropatía patelofemoral.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Menisco lateral es de morfología y señal conservada, sin signos de rotura.
Aumento de señal central del cuerno posterior y cuerpo del menisco medial que no contacta de
manera categórica la superficie articular, sin caracteres propios de rotura.
Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial y prácticamente total de la región central de la zona de carga
del cóndilo femoral medial. El resto de los cartílagos femorotibiales y de la tróclea femoral sin
alteraciones. Úlceras condrales de espesor total con discretos cambios óseos secundarios a la
rótula de distribución difusa.
No hay significativo derrame articular ni quistes poplíteos.
Leve aumento de señal del tercio proximal del rotuliano, sin signos de rotura. Tendón cuadricipital,
tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites conservados.
Impresión:
Condropatía lesiones grado 2 y 3 de la región central de la zona de carga del cóndilo femoral
medial.
Condropatía lesiones grado 3 y 4 de la rótula.
Leve tendinosis rotuliana proximal

Central supporting system 
- Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Loss of ACL signal intensity, loss morphology and discontinuity; chronic complete tear without avulsion is suggested. 
- Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Buckling PCL without abnormal SI. 
- Anterior tibial translation: Presented, measured about 1.1 cm. 

Medial compartment 
- Medial meniscus: Myxoid changed. 
- Medial collateral ligament: Slightly high signal within deep part; mild sprain is suggested. 
- Medial tibial plateau: Preserved articular cartilage without definite fracture 
- Medial femoral condyle: Preserved articular cartilage without definite fracture. 

Lateral compartment 
- Lateral meniscus: multiple chronic tear lesion as describe below 
-- Longitudinal tear from anterior horn down to anterior root 
-- Oblique vertical tear from posterior root down to peripheral surface but preserve insertion of posterior root. 
-- Radical tear at posterior horn. 

- Iliotibial band: Intact. 
- Lateral collateral ligament: Intact. 
- Popliteus tendon: High SI without disruption; mild sprain at proximal part is suggested. 
- Popliteofibular ligament: Intact. 
- Biceps femoris tendon : Intact. 
- Lateral tibial plateau: Preserved articular cartilage without definite fracture. 
- Lateral femoral condyle: Preserved articular cartilage without definite fracture. 

Patellofemoral compartment 
- Quadriceps tendon: Intact. 
- Patellar tendon: intact. 
- Medial patellar retinaculum: Intact. 
- Lateral patellar retinaculum: Intact. 
- Mild subcutaneous edema around patella 

Others 
- Muscle: Unremarkable. 
- Bursa: Unremarkable 
- Bone: 
-- Adjacent to ACL tear, there is faint bone bruise at lateral condyle and posterior proximal aspect of tibial plateua. 
-- - Secondary bony degeneration at lateral part of tibial and femur by evidence of osteophyte and subchrodosclerosis. 
- Neurovascular bundles: Intact. 
- Effusion within patellofemoral joints up to suprapatella bursa. 

IMPRESSIONL: 
- Chronic complete tear of ACL. 
- Multiple chronic lateral meniscus tear at anterior horn, posterior horn and posterior part, however posterior root is preserved. 
- Mild sprain of proximal part of popliteal ligament. 
- Mild sprain of medial collateral ligament. 
- Secondary bony degeneration. 
- Residual faint bone bruise at lateral condyle and posterior proximal aspect of tibial plateua 
- Effusion within patellofemoral joints up to suprapatella bursa.

Aktuell regelrechte Artikulation im rechten Kniegelenk. Deutliche intraossäre T2 Signalanhebungen dorsal im Tibiaplateau, führend lateralseitig (4/24) sowie an beiden Femurkondylen am Rand (4/18). Minimales intraossäre Signalanhebungen auch ventral im medialen Tibiaplateau (4/12).
Patella minimal lateralisiert. Ansonsten unauffällig. Unauffälliger Knorpelbelag femoropatellar.
Femorotibial ebenfalls unauffälliger Knorpelbelag ohne Nachweis einer Chondropathie. Außen- und Innenmeniskus intakt. Das hintere Kreuzband unauffällig. Das vordere Kreuzband deutlich signalangehoben mit geringem Tonusverlust (z. B. 5/16) und nicht sicher durchgehend abgrenzbar.
V. a. Partialläsion des MCL bei femoralseitig deutlicher Signalanhebung der ventralen Anteile (4/18 oder 7/12). Geringe Flüssigkeit um das LCL, dieses ansonsten durchgehend abgrenzbar. Moderater Gelenkerguss. Plica mediopatellaris (Typ A). Unauffällige Darstellung der umgebenden Muskulatur und Subkutis. Fabella.

Findings: There is a minor knee effusion. Normal medial and lateral menisci. No evidence of tears.  Normal ACL, PCL, MCL and LCL. Normal extensor mechanism.  Normal tibiofemoral articular cartilage. There is mild thinning and fraying of the patellar articular cartilage. Normal trochlear articular cartilage. 
 Conclusion: Mild patellar chondral degeneration. Minor knee effusion. No other significant abnormality.
